body:
Attempt #2
  • Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed): Flamey_Sorcerer
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned: Aimbot
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server.
             | you have been punished by javipepe for Hacking is not allowed - aimbot [Video] on june 24, 2015 2:31:18 PM| 
 I am making a second appeal because Avicus is my one favorite server and i would not do anything ridiculous like Hacking to lose access to one of my favorite server of all time. I would appreciate it if another staff besides the previous staff that denied me review the evidence to see if i am hacking or not, Take into account there could be visual glitches or glitches in Control The Hill one i know glitches staff are aware of but hasn't been patched is fast hitting glitch. i appreciate the staff for reading my appeal thank you - Flamey_Sorcerer
https://www.youtube.com/watch?t=19&v=TFtUv-CBDdk - Evidence to review
